# Logistics 0.1.3 Alpha 7

This alpha updates the mobile document workspace, navigation and Settings.

- Home buttons combine their icons, titles and italic descriptions in one tap target.
- Document buttons include their local, cloud and lock indicators; opened files use their names in the iOS navigation bar.
- Workspaces and file browsing use consistent rows, folder hierarchy guides and source navigation.
- Settings groups related options and keeps native controls and category navigation.
- Markdown editing keeps the caret visible above the keyboard on short screens and with enlarged text.
- Android deployments refresh app dependencies alongside source updates.
- Native Home-button checks support the two-line labels, and accessibility descriptions avoid repeating their subtitles.

Release validation also updates mobile runtime evidence for document deletion,
keeps encrypted document history behind an injected host contract, and fixes
native source-switch and Qt documentation-test lifecycle handling. Workspaces
documentation links and native folder-icon checks follow the current UI.

This candidate fixes native iOS grouped-folder measurement and verifies that
closing browser search clears its filter and hides the search controls.

Mobile documentation navigation is validated through the grouped Settings controls.

Native visual review waits for comic layout to settle and measures the current browser toolbar and visible search controls.
